title: Gauge-Ring Phone Mount for Porsche 911 964 and 993
notes: One STL declared for an 82 mm dashboard gauge and a WizGear holder. Accessory rather than OEM replacement; verify gauge fit, surface protection and exact licence version before use. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-THINGIVERSE-993-PHONE-MOUNT (Thingiverse thing 3143518). On 2026-10-15 the original Thingiverse page (thing 3143518) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index holds only redirects of the thing's ZIP download, not a capture of the page. The CC-BY (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page.
